_research_strategy_comment: Web research goes through OUR tools — never opencode built-ins. webfetch + websearch are disabled below so the LLM is forced to use playwright-search (multi-engine search + extraction) and pullmd (Cloudflare/Reddit-aware URL→markdown fallback). This eliminates the most common research-flakiness root cause: LLMs reaching for opencode's built-in webfetch and getting raw HTML or rate-limited.

mempalace._comment: Local AI memory system — verbatim conversation recall + temporal knowledge graph. Fixes the 'local LLMs have no memory between sessions' problem. Install: pip install mempalace && mempalace init ~/projects/<project>

playwright-search._comment: PRIMARY research backbone. Free local web research — multi-engine search (DDG + Brave + Bing) + page extraction (Mozilla Readability) + 24h cache. Polite (rate-limited per-domain, robots.txt). Tools: web_research, web_search, web_fetch. Build with `npm run build` in /Users/user/Code/playwright-search, then point command at dist/mcp.js. For dev, use tsx: ['npx','tsx','/Users/user/Code/playwright-search/src/mcp.ts'].

pullmd._comment: OPTIONAL FALLBACK — disabled by default. URL → clean markdown via 4-stage pipeline: Reddit handler → Cloudflare native MD → Readability+Trafilatura → headless Playwright. AGPL, self-hosted Docker. Use when playwright-search_web_fetch fails on JS-heavy or Cloudflare-protected pages. Tools: read_url, get_share, list_recent. To enable: install with `./install.sh --pullmd` (clones repo, `docker compose up -d`, flips this `enabled` flag to true), or manually clone https://github.com/AeternaLabsHQ/pullmd, run `docker compose up -d`, then set enabled:true here. Leaving enabled:true without a running container will cause MCP startup errors.

lmstudio.name: LM Studio (local)
